title: Grateful Dead Live at Pittsburgh Civic Arena on 1973-09-24

ai_review.summary: Stunning soundboard capture with the boys in top form, highlighted by a soaring Let It Grow and a clean Truckin' performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear, “sick” sound quality that lets every nuance of the band shine. Fans rave about the energetic playing – especially the standout Let It Grow and a tight version of Truckin' – and consider this show a solid addition to any rotation despite no single performance being called out as weak.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are highly positive (average ~4.7 stars) with consistent praise for both the audio fidelity and the musical performance, giving a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers describe the sound as “sick,” “great,” and “awesome,” indicating a crisp, well‑balanced capture with no noted issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set list is regarded as solid and enjoyable; while not labeled the absolute best, it’s considered a good representation of the era and keeps the momentum high throughout.
